digest_policy: Compute a canonical content digest when implemented; null is an explicit placeholder, not a verified hash.
title: Preserve continuous driving without discarding distinctive stopped views
purpose: A composable editing heuristic, not a scenic-location runbook, executable skill or movement certificate.

retrieval.match_is_not_proof: A retrieval match neither establishes vehicle movement nor authorizes applying this SOP.

preconditions.user_intent: The current job requests a sense of continuous driving; this is not inferred from vehicle presence alone.
preconditions.subject: Inspected evidence identifies a vehicle as a relevant subject.
preconditions.motion_evidence: Movement, stopping and continuity claims require timestamped motion evidence over the claimed scope; sparse stills cannot prove them.
preconditions.unknown: Request one bounded relevant preview if permitted by remaining budget; otherwise retain unknown and defer the affected claim.
preconditions.scope: Every claim binds asset revision, actual source window, playback speed, output FPS and inspected evidence IDs.

procedure.instruction: Inspect the previous ending, proposed shot and next opening. Separate vehicle movement, camera movement and an unobserved gap; do not assume travel was uninterrupted.

For an uncertain start, stop or reversal, request a bounded muted proxy covering the relevant transition at the proposed playback speed and output FPS. Stay inside existing upload and preview budgets.

Prefer verified moving windows that preserve the requested action, chronology and content variety. Suggest trimming or replacing redundant stopping intervals; the client solver determines feasible exact windows and slots.

Retain a stopped view when authorized and it contributes independently evidenced distant mountains, clouds or difficult terrain ahead that alternatives lack. Explain its narrative role instead of treating every stop as redundant.

Run existing local validation and inspect the affected joins using the actual proposed windows and speed. Recheck semantic coverage after trimming; a prior parent-window observation cannot certify an unseen new join.

authority.precedence: Runtime contracts and current user policy take precedence over all SOP recommendations.
authority.exception_authorization: Reuse an existing job allowance. If retention contradicts an explicit hard requirement, only a user-authorized policy revision can permit it; do not repeatedly request an authorization already given.

counterexamples: A parked vehicle reveals a unique distant plateau, cloud formation or difficult route ahead.
A vehicle appears stationary in two sparse images but moves between them; stills are insufficient evidence.
The intended chapter concerns arrival or exploration rather than continuous driving.

provenance.feedback_summary: Illustrative request to remove a redundant stop between driving shots while retaining a distinctive authorized landscape view.
provenance.limits: All references are synthetic. No original media, private feedback or actual improvement result is represented.

promotion_policy.current_job: An explicit user correction applies immediately to the current job revision; learning must not delay it.
promotion_policy.candidate_creation: Automatically extract a private candidate with provenance, conditions, exceptions and uncertainty; no confirmation is required for every candidate.
promotion_policy.private_trial: Allow a bounded, reversible trial under existing user policy; pin each decision snapshot, record applied SOP versions in the plan, and retain the previous plan.
promotion_policy.explicit_preference: Persist an expressly stated user preference at its stated scope without repeatedly asking; do not silently turn a local exception into a universal preference.
promotion_policy.generalization: Before wider cross-task activation, compare replay baselines, independent capture sessions and counterexamples; one correction or model self-rating is insufficient.
promotion_policy.public_release: Requires separately authorized sharing and maintained review/redaction; private learning never automatically publishes user material.

conflicts_and_rollback.conflict: Follow current explicit user intent and hard requirements. If SOPs recommend incompatible edits, preserve uncertainty or omit the weaker recommendation rather than blend away the conflict.
conflicts_and_rollback.disable: Disable a specific SOP version by its verified digest; record the reason and stop selecting it for new plan revisions.
conflicts_and_rollback.existing_plans: Do not silently mutate pinned plans. Revert trial preferences and revalidate in a new revision; do not bypass existing cancellation or commit rules.

track: SOP actually applied, not merely retrieved

evaluation.baseline: Same candidate catalog, music grid, task policy and rule versions without this SOP.
evaluation.prerequisite: All unchanged local technical and user-policy gates must pass; technical success alone does not demonstrate editorial improvement.
